question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"living".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here the sentence is in **Present Perfect Continuous Tense. **So the sentence will be My cousins have been living there since a long time.
 
• **Structure :** Subject + has/have been + V¹ +ing + for/since + obj.
 
 
• **​For example : **Sahil have been working in Microsoft company since 2012.
 
 
• **For is used in period of time & since is used in point of time.**
